verdict.rationale: The only stakeholder-facing evidence is a 'My Equity' view where a holder can see their grants and exercise options. Stockholder consent workflows also email signers a link to review and sign documents. This is a thin, option-grant-oriented stakeholder view, not a documented investor portal, and nothing shows structured investor updates. Missing for 10: a documented investor-specific portal showing share or preferred holdings, a structured investor update or reporting feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my investors get their own portal view of their holdings and can receive structured updates without emailing me for the cap table

citations.quote: click on My Equity to view your available grants.
create a written consent for board directors or stockholders and solicit approvals using the Board Consent and Stockholder Consent workflows
the platform will email you a link to review and sign the document(s) involved in that step of the workflow
